exposure: severe maternal morbidity in the first delivery
outcome: offspring composite severe neonatal morbidity in second delivery
perinatal mortality (stillbirths or neonatal deaths within 28 days after birth) in second delivery
severe maternal morbidity in second delivery
cohort: The study included two population-based cohorts of mothers in Sweden and British Columbia, Canada, who had records for both their first and second deliveries.
finding: Severe maternal morbidity in the first delivery was associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy, delivery, and offspring outcomes in the subsequent delivery in both Sweden and British Columbia.
mod_finding: Severe maternal morbidity in the first delivery was associated with an increased risk of both elective and cesarean delivery in the second delivery in British Columbia.
followup_time: 42 days postpartum (for maternal outcomes of the second delivery); 28 days postpartum (for neonatal outcomes of the second delivery)
